opportunities.title: National Lottery Heritage Grants £10,000 to £250,000
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Not-for-profit organisations, private owners of a heritage asset, and partnerships. Organisations need a bank account, a governing document, and two or more members that are not related or living at the same address.
opportunities.summary: Funding programme for all types of heritage projects in the UK, from £10,000 to £250,000. No deadline; applications are open all year round. Projects must care for and sustain heritage in the UK, run for no more than five years, and take into account the four investment principles.

opportunities.title: National Lottery Heritage Grants £250,000 to £10million

amount.raw: grants from £250,000 to £10m (exceptional projects over £10m may be considered)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Not-for-profit organisations and partnerships led by a not-for-profit organisation. Organisations need a bank account, a governing document, and two or more members that are not related or living at the same address.
opportunities.summary: Funding programme for heritage projects in the UK requesting grants from £250,000 to £10million. Requires a two-phase application (development phase of up to two years, then delivery phase of no more than five years), with quarterly application deadlines. Applicants must first submit an Expression of Interest.
